reviews.text: I greatly appreciated the warm welcome we received during this first visit, right from the initial phone call to book the appointment. The veterinarian's professionalism was also undeniable. Thank you to the entire team, and see you next time.
A very unpleasant experience on the phone; the woman was in a bad mood and condescending. I won't be coming to your establishment.

Avoid this clinic! The lack of professionalism is blatant, and I seriously doubt the practitioner's competence. I strongly recommend getting a second opinion if you consult with them at this establishment.
The receptionist was very accommodating and lent me a carrier for my cat (mine had lost its door); Dr. Allgeyer was very attentive and professional, I highly recommend him.
Very good local veterinary clinic
Very warm welcome

Hello,
Thank you so much for your trust and positive feedback!
With our best wishes to you and your pet,
The Veterinary Team

Hello,
Thank you so much for your positive feedback! We are delighted that you were satisfied with your visit to our veterinary clinic.

Sincerely,
The Mon Véto Paris 19 Jaures Team

I received a cold and irritated welcome from Claire Allgeyer.

I came very worried about my animals, hoping to find a professional who loved their work.

I absolutely did not expect to feel unwelcome in this clinic, which had a kind and attentive team a few years ago. Avoid at all costs.
Good clinic

Excellent welcome. The doctor seemed perhaps a little reserved at first. Very competent, frank about my pet's condition. A lot of empathy. Very clean premises. I highly recommend this veterinary clinic.

Avoid at all costs!

You have to go in for a visit to get flea/tick treatment if your dog hasn't been treated there for a while. It's clear they're just looking to squeeze money out of you!
It's a far cry from the days on Rue Meynadier!

My 14-year-old dog has been a patient at this clinic for years. I've always been very well received in these lovely premises. With the exception of two rather unpleasant experiences with a male vet, the female vets who work at this clinic are all very competent and wonderful with my old girl.

A very warm welcome from Nathalie, Pascale, and Loreane. Thank you for your kindness. Likewise, thank you to the veterinarians who are very efficient and attentive.
A fantastic team in a fantastic clinic!
Very professional, very attentive, very available, and a very good veterinarian.

This veterinarian was shockingly incompetent and showed a complete lack of empathy towards my old cat and me. She accused me of mistreating my cat and totally ignored my problem. After biting him, she refused to administer the injection for the tests. She talked about cancer, jaw necrosis, CT scans, and radiotherapy—in short, she made me feel so guilty that I left in tears and destitute, having spent €96 for… nothing 🙀.
So this Dr. Claire Allgeyer should never have practiced and should never have to practice again; she's a disgrace! Run away from her as fast as you can, seriously.
The reception and consultation were very satisfactory.
Thank you to Pascale, Nathalie, and Dr. Allgeyer for their warm welcome during our first visit. We were received with great kindness.
Professional and friendly

First appointment for my cat, whom I adopted 6 months ago and who had been sneezing for a few weeks.

We were very well received, and the vet was very attentive during the consultation.

I also found the premises very clean and pleasant.
I recommend them!

A veterinary clinic that prioritizes animal well-being and reassures owners.

The reception is warm and the medical care is effective.
Warm welcome. The vets are very competent; I highly recommend this clinic for your animals.
The quality of service was exceptional and my pet was taken care of quickly.
First appointment at this clinic for my kitten Anouk. Very welcoming reception staff and a veterinarian who listened attentively to my pet's well-being. I highly recommend them!

I'm very surprised by some of the comments. There are certainly more dissatisfied people taking the time to leave reviews...

My experience was excellent: I came without an appointment for a minor emergency with my dog ​​and was seen very quickly between appointments. From the reception to the veterinarian, everything was great.

Regarding the prices, I didn't find it more expensive than elsewhere.

A big thank you to Pascale, who was fantastic! I highly recommend this clinic.

Honestly, absolutely no use.

The staff is awful, the vet worse than anyone else.

They have no empathy whatsoever, neither for the animals nor for those who care for them. Our cat's vaccination was rushed through during a "annual cat check-up" in a mere 5 minutes, with no examination whatsoever.
We went back to make another appointment this year, and they yelled at us on the phone (you have to be kidding me to do that!) that the vaccine's effectiveness was only valid until November and that we would have to schedule several appointments close together (???). But we're not masochists, that's for sure 🙂 Thanks and goodbye

Avoid this place. Extraordinarily high prices (twice as much as where I'll be going from now on), pushes you to spend money unnecessarily (they don't mention booster shots, and if you miss them, you obviously have to pay double), and the service is unpleasant (they completely disregarded the animal's stress level on two separate occasions).

The receptionists are very kind and competent.

Hello Alesha Popovich,

Thank you for your review. Our clinic team is delighted with your feedback and continues to strive to provide attentive and personalized care to each patient with professionalism and compassion.

Hello Catherine Clausse,
Thank you so much for your excellent rating!
Your satisfaction is our priority, and we are delighted that your experience at our clinic was positive.

Hello Julie Raynal,
We sincerely thank you for this positive review. The entire team at the veterinary clinic places great importance on client satisfaction and the medical care of their animals.
Friendly welcome, nice doctor, honestly highly recommended
The vet and the staff were incredibly kind to my kitten (who unfortunately I had to give back to the shelter). Next time I adopt another cat/kitten, I will definitely go back there.

A disaster! These people are cruel to animals.
Avoid at all costs!
Our cat is usually treated at the Crimée clinic, but they can't do dental cleanings right now, so we made an appointment at the Jaurès clinic sometime in October.

And it's because our cat was mistreated that we turned to the veterinary clinic in the 20th arrondissement.

A very bad experience. The vet refused to examine my cat because he was stressed, whereas other clinics have never had this problem.

She gave me medication to "calm him down" and told me to come back in a week (but I had to pay for both appointments, of course), without mentioning that it would sedate him for at least seven hours. This is completely unacceptable for a simple consultation. The other vets I consulted afterward were shocked that I was asked to have him sedated for a routine checkup. Furthermore, the doctors were quite unpleasant; it was clear they had no real concern for the animal, just a desire to get their job done quickly.
Our miniature dachshund has been followed by the clinic since the beginning and is in good hands. The welcome was lovely, the care effective, we are truly reassured to have them in our neighborhood.
Excellent welcome, always finds the right solution, friendly and understanding, I highly recommend, a very good center for our four-legged companions!
Friendly and attentive service. Professional veterinarian with excellent advice. I recommend them.

My little cat has been a patient there for a year now, and I have nothing but praise. The veterinary assistants are truly exceptional. They have always taken great care of her and taken the time to explain everything and reassure me when she was spayed and I was anxious. The vet is always wonderful. I have absolutely no complaints. It's always a pleasure to see them again.
Friendly welcome and very professional care of the animals.

I came to explain the vaccines I needed for my dog, they didn't even let me explain, they didn't even listen, "bahbahbah it's complicated" "it's the weekend you have to go somewhere else" OK no problem I'll pass the instructions on to my friends.

ABSOLUTELY AVOID

The vets completely neglected the animal's care, their explanation of the clinical case was utterly inadequate, they didn't listen to the owners at all, and follow-up care is only available in your dreams. My pet's problems were not treated, and my case was completely neglected. Legal proceedings have been initiated and are underway to shut down this totally negligent establishment because when you ask for explanations, they hang up on you.

PS: ALL THE NICE REVIEWS ON THIS PAGE WERE BOUGHT
Top-notch clinic, very clean, excellent vet and staff.

ABSOLUTELY AVOID THIS PLACE!!!

Hello, I've lived in Paris for 17 years and this is the first time I've ever had such an experience!!!!
We made an appointment and waited a week for it. On the day of the appointment, we arrived at the clinic on time, and the receptionist told us our appointment had been canceled!!!! We asked by whom, how, and when it was canceled, and she said she had no idea!!! Her facial expressions and gestures made it clear she was lying... why? Because we went to the clinic two days before and asked if we could reschedule for Saturday (our appointment was on Tuesday)... she said it wasn't possible and if it was urgent, we should go to the emergency room... and we left the vet's office saying we'd have to wait for our Tuesday appointment... and in the meantime, our appointment was canceled... Is it the system? The receptionist? Who canceled our appointment? And why didn't we inquire by phone or email?! She asks Dr. Dol, the veterinarian, and we hear her voice at the door. We immediately understand her snobbish response, and it's clear she doesn't care about our cat's health! She doesn't even come out for two seconds to check on our cat! She says she can't see us because she has other appointments... and what about our appointment with Dr. Dol?! Why is this practice's irresponsibility being placed on us?! Why did you cancel our appointment without any notification?! And the way you spoke to us... I can't believe it! Not even a greeting at reception... not a goodbye! These people are just accepting their irresponsibility... they are completely unprofessional! And not serious at all... they don't care about the well-being of your animals!

So AVOID AT ALL COSTS

Don't leave your animals with these irresponsible people who don't care about your animals' health...
The reception was very unpleasant.
The team is very friendly, they were all very patient with my screaming little cat and he even got a little treat.
Very satisfied, the animals are very well cared for, and we, the clients, are very well received by this clinic and Dr. Mercie.
Dr. Jouin is very attentive and gentle with animals. The team is truly lovely. Thank you.

The assistants are always smiling, and the reception is excellent. Dr. Jouin is gentle with animals and very competent.
I am very happy with this clinic.
I highly recommend it.
Excellent welcome, expertise, well done!
A very caring and competent team with animals!
